selected_sources.title: STream3R: Scalable Sequential 3D Reconstruction with Causal Transformer
selected_sources.selection_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 paper in the official OpenReview venue collection and the strongest direct match: streaming/sequential 3D reconstruction, causal online processing, and pointmap prediction.
selected_sources.expected_use: Primary evidence for online point-map-based 3D reconstruction from ordered image/video streams.

selected_sources.title: StreamSplat: Towards Online Dynamic 3D Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Video Streams
selected_sources.selection_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 paper in the official OpenReview venue collection and a direct match for online dynamic 3D reconstruction from uncalibrated video streams.
selected_sources.expected_use: Primary evidence for online feed-forward reconstruction under streaming latency and memory constraints, with Gaussian Splatting as the scene representation.

selected_sources.title: $\pi^3$: Permutation-Equivariant Visual Geometry Learning
selected_sources.selection_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 paper in the official OpenReview venue collection; highly relevant to dense/local point maps and video geometry, though not framed primarily as online streaming.
selected_sources.expected_use: Contextual evidence for point-map prediction, visual geometry model design, and video/dense reconstruction evaluation.

selected_sources.title: CogniMap3D: Cognitive 3D Mapping and Rapid Retrieval
selected_sources.selection_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 paper in the official OpenReview venue collection; relevant to persistent 3D mapping from image streams and reconstruction-oriented evaluations.
selected_sources.expected_use: Secondary evidence for stream-based 3D mapping, memory mechanisms, and retrieval-oriented reconstruction workflows.

selected_sources.title: Hyden: A Hybrid Dual-Path Encoder for Monocular Geometry of High-resolution Images
selected_sources.selection_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 paper in the official OpenReview venue collection; relevant to low-latency high-resolution monocular geometry and point-map estimation, but image-focused rather than streaming-video focused.
selected_sources.expected_use: Supporting evidence for efficient point-map/depth/normal estimation that may inform streaming reconstruction components.

selected_sources.title: FastAvatar: Towards Unified and Fast 3D Avatar Reconstruction with Large Gaussian Reconstruction Transformers
selected_sources.selection_rationale: Accepted ICLR 2026 paper in the official OpenReview venue collection; relevant to fast/incremental reconstruction from monocular video, but domain-specific to avatars rather than general 3D scene point maps.
selected_sources.expected_use: Narrow supporting evidence for incremental video-based reconstruction and fast feed-forward 3D reconstruction design.

coverage_gaps.gap: The official CVPR 2026 papers page was reachable but its paper list requires JavaScript and did not expose searchable paper records in the retrieved text. CVF Open Access searches for CVPR 2026 did not return in-scope official proceedings matches for the query.
Scoped OpenReview searches for ICML 2026 with online/streaming/video/3D reconstruction/point-map terms returned no candidate results.

Several plausible CVPR 2026 candidates appeared only on author, project, institutional, or GitHub pages. They were not used as in-scope evidence because the plan allows author-hosted PDFs only after matching papers to accepted venue collections.
